requestedText: Disable automatic redirects on the existing Telegram transport agent without changing payload, retry, receipt, or secret-loading behavior.

evidence: The change is a fixed ureq AgentBuilder setting; it adds no dynamic loading, reflection, or plugin resolution.
EnvTelegramTransport and send_rendered_report public signatures remain unchanged; no external consumer migration is introduced.
The agent setting adds no monitoring, scheduler, webhook, or publication contract beyond the existing transport.
The Contract prohibits real Telegram calls and requires existing secret-safe and retry tests to remain passing.
